title: Question on the page "Create a calendar widget"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[Create a calendar widget](__LOCATION__)".

I am struggling to get this to work when my date is within an array. My data is coming from craft cms and therefore outputs like so;

"eventDate": {
"localeDate": "5/12/2017",
"localeTime": "2:30 PM",
"nice": "May 12, 2017, 2:30:00 PM",
"mysql": "2017-05-12 14:30:00",
"cookie": "Friday, 12-May-2017 14:30:00 UTC",
"timestamp": "1494599400"
},

I think the issue is due to the **eventdate.timestap** being a **string** rather than **numeric** value. Is there a way I can change this when being assigned to the **attributeName**. Thank you!
